cs.t: Same, but with N97 (which is IIRC more powerful than the N100, because Intel is weird). Wanted a travel NAS that would run on USB-C power. Thought about a Raspi5 + M.2 HAT + case. Checked the final price at checkout. Bought a GMKTec Nucbox G7 instead. RAM is soldered in, but it has 12GB which is more than enough for the foreseeable future. 512GB SSD - again, more than enough and I can upgrade it later. Now it runs Debian with a local Plex installation along with my Gl.inet router so I can get my series fix even if the internet is spotty when I'm traveling :)
cs.th: I Bought an N100 Mini PC, Then Another
